Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Michael Kaszubski wrote:
>
> What to do when a minion with a base hand damage greater than one
> (Lazverinus, Garou etc., Art of Pain) strikes with a weapon inflicting +X
> hand damage? Is the hand damage added to the weapon damage (as with the
> Wooden Stake) or is it treated as 1?

The minion's base hand damage (his "strength") is part of the effect.
The weapon strike inflicts "strength"+X damage.
